note: Built-in skills and agents ship inside the Claude Code binary, so no file on disk lists them. Update this list when Claude Code adds or drops one.

skills.name: init
skills.description: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation

skills.name: simplify
skills.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

skills.name: loop
skills.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval, or let the model self-pace.

skills.name: schedule
skills.description: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule.

skills.name: claude-api
skills.description: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching.

skills.name: run
skills.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working, or screenshot the app.

skills.name: update-config
skills.description: Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks, permissions, env vars.

skills.name: keybindings-help
skills.description: Customize keyboard shortcuts and chord bindings in ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

skills.name: fewer-permission-prompts
skills.description: Scan transcripts for common read-only tool calls and add a prioritized allowlist to project settings.

agents.name: general-purpose
agents.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks.

agents.name: Explore
agents.description: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches across many files when only the conclusion is needed.

agents.name: Plan
agents.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans and weighing architectural trade-offs.

agents.name: statusline-setup
agents.description: Configure the user's Claude Code status line setting.

agents.name: claude-code-guide
agents.description: Answer questions about Claude Code features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, the Agent SDK and the Claude API.
